notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Maya Lin).
Primary contact: maya.lin@glasspointvector.com, CTO: rafael@glasspointvector.com.

Context: Mid-market SaaS platform for B2B search + recommendations across customer docs and product catalogs. Decided to eval Redwood after initial tests with OpenAI + Pinecone showed cost and latency concerns at scale. Want hosted API for quick ramp, then Dedicated in prod if POC meets latency/price.

POC scope: ingest ~500k embeddings (batch job), nightly incremental embedding job (~20k/day), query throughput target 150 QPS peak, median p99 latency target <120ms for top-k search end-to-end (embedding + vector DB + rerank).

What we tried: Pinecone + OpenAI embeddings as baseline. Pinecone vector store showed stable recall but 200-350ms tail at 150 QPS; cost per 1M tokens + vector ops felt high. GlassPoint ran a small canary with hosted Redwood (beta access) for 2 weeks — saw improvements on batching suggestions, but need full Dedicated perf numbers.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) mandatory, KMS for key management, audit logs for queries, data residency preference: US/EU. Also asked about retention controls for query logs and embeddings.

Quotes/feedback from calls:
- "We need predictable unit economics once we cross 10M tokens/month." — Maya
- "If dedicated can cut vector + embed costs by ~30% vs our baseline and meet latency, procurement greenlights." — Rafael (CTO)

Sales interactions:
- 2026-01-28 discovery call (ff_20260128_883). AE: Sofia. SE: Evan. Went through high-level architecture and integration points.
- 2026-02-11 technical deep-dive demo (ff_20260211_321). Showed batching, KV cache, and routing. GlassPoint asked for Dedicated sizing guidance.
- 2026-02-20 POC kickoff. Provided sample ingestion script and RBAC pointers.

POC milestones and status:
- Ingested 120k of 500k vectors (batch pipeline in progress).
- Initial query perf (hosted) at 80 QPS: p95 70ms, p99 190ms (vector DB end-to-end).
- Need Dedicated CPU/GPU sizing to estimate cost; Redwood proposed two configs (m-medium, m-large) to test.
- SE running back-to-back batch job with prefix caching enabled to measure cache hit improvements.

Integration notes:
- Vector DB preference: they currently run Milvus in-house; open to managed Pinecone or Redwood-managed vector cache if we provide connectors.
- Wants out-of-the-box connector for Milvus and guidance for nightly bulk-upsert batching.
- Key ask: ability to run batch embedding jobs via Redwood CLI with rate limits and retry semantics.

Pricing conversation:
- Finance wants a 12-month committed Dedicated quote with predictable committed throughput and an overage model.
- They asked for an ARR estimate for two committed tiers: 150 QPS baseline and 300 QPS baseline.

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver POC perf report with Dedicated projection by 2026-03-03.
- Pricing call scheduled 2026-03-05 with Finance and Procurement.
- Confirm SAML cert rotation window and sign NDA addendum for EU data residency testing.

Other notes:
- Prefers terse onboarding docs and sample terraform for VPC peering.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization; wants to see cost delta on 8-bit quantized models.
- Possible timeline: production Dedicated by Q2 2026 if POC passes and procurement approves.
